$comment: Time-limited, evidence-based production dependency exceptions. Consumed by scripts/ci/security-gate.mjs. Every entry MUST have an expiry (no permanent accepted risk). A CRITICAL is never allowed here — it must be remediated. Each covers HIGH advisories in a package that currently has NO available non-major fix, with a documented exploitability analysis, compensating control, owner and upgrade plan. Review AUD-P1-001/AUD-P1-008.

policy.notes: Gate fails on any production Critical (no exceptions), and any production High not covered by a non-expired exception below.

exceptions.exploitability: LOW — the SSRF advisory is in Server Actions; SafeBet IQ does NOT use Server Actions ('use server' not present) and experimental.serverActions is not enabled. Cache-poisoning is fixed at 13.5.11. Remaining advisories require Next 14/15.
exceptions.compensatingControl: No Server Actions in the codebase; production served behind CloudFront/WAF; route handlers validate auth server-side per request.
exceptions.approvedBy: Meeshan Naidoo (required for the Next major upgrade)
exceptions.upgradePlan: Isolated Next 14.2 LTS upgrade milestone (App Router compatibility test + full regression + Playwright) — not bundled with this remediation.

advisories: GHSA-r28c-9q8g-f849 (XSS via unescaped </style> in CSS stringify)
exceptions.fixAvailable: none published at time of writing (8.5.15 is latest)
exceptions.exploitability: LOW — postcss runs at BUILD time only (Tailwind/Next CSS pipeline). SafeBet IQ processes no attacker-controlled CSS; no runtime CSS stringify of untrusted input.
exceptions.compensatingControl: Build-time only; static first-party CSS; no user-supplied stylesheets.
exceptions.upgradePlan: Bump postcss to the patched release as soon as it is published on npm.

exceptions.fixAvailable: none in the 3.x line (latest 3.3.12); fix only in nanoid 5.x (ESM-only, breaking for CJS consumers)
exceptions.exploitability: LOW — nanoid is a transitive of @supabase/supabase-js and is invoked internally with fixed positive sizes; the vulnerable path requires an attacker-controlled zero/negative size, which SafeBet IQ never passes.
exceptions.compensatingControl: No user-controlled nanoid size; transitive, not called directly.
exceptions.upgradePlan: Adopt nanoid 5.x when @supabase/supabase-js requires it and the project's ESM/CJS boundary supports it.

exceptions.fixAvailable: none published (advisory fix 8.20.1/8.21.0 not on npm; latest is 8.20.0)
exceptions.exploitability: LOW — ws is a transitive of @supabase/realtime-js. In the browser, realtime uses the native WebSocket (ws is a Node polyfill, not shipped to the client); the SafeBet IQ server does not open Supabase realtime connections in the request path.
exceptions.compensatingControl: Not on the runtime request path; browser uses native WebSocket.
exceptions.upgradePlan: Bump ws to 8.20.1+/8.21.0 as soon as it is published on npm.
